summary: The review runner starts a shell-reading harness by its real path and, on macOS, with the system PATH, so codex can start and read under its committed read profile

replay.detail: Review tooling only; no replay or rebuild.

rules.detail: No rules changes; the runner's read-profile check is unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No runtime, wire or client changes.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the previous way of starting the harness.
